ledger.sentence: The WHO announced its recommendation for the 2027 southern hemisphere flu season on 25 September 2026, after a consultation held from 21 to 24 September.

ledger.sentence: The 2027 southern hemisphere viruses differ from those recommended for the 2026 southern hemisphere vaccine.
On 25 September 2026 the World Health Organization (WHO) announced its recommendations for the virus strains in influenza vaccines for the 2027 southern hemisphere season.
The recommendation followed a consultation held from 21 to 24 September 2026.
National regulators and manufacturers use the recommendations in vaccine development and licensing.
For egg-based vaccines the WHO recommends an A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1)pdm09-like virus, an A/Darwin/1454/2025 (H3N2)-like virus and a B/Tokyo/EIS13-175/2025 (B/Victoria lineage)-like virus.

The WHO says the 2027 southern hemisphere viruses differ from those recommended for the 2026 southern hemisphere vaccine, and that they match the components recommended for the 2026-27 northern hemisphere vaccine.

ledger.sentence: A separate recommendation for the 2027-28 northern hemisphere season is planned for February 2027.
